name: Khanmigo
shortDescription: Khan Academy tutor for almost any subject. Learners are $4 a month, and teachers can sign up free.
longDescription: Khanmigo's learners page calls it an always-available tutor for almost any academic subject, from elementary school through college, including math, science, coding, history, and humanities. Learners and parents pay $4 a month or $44 a year. Teachers can sign up free in supported places.
pricingNotes: Learners and parents pay $4 a month or $44 a year. Teachers can sign up free in supported places.
freeTierNotes: Teachers can sign up free in supported places. Learners and parents pay.
bestFor: Tutoring and teacher help inside Khan Academy's assistant
notIdealFor: A family account without the learner subscription
strength: Khanmigo tutors almost any academic subject from elementary school through college, and learners are $4 a month.
weakness: Parents and learners pay for access, and a teacher sign-up does not cover a family account.
smokeTestNotes: Official page checked on 2026-10-19. No account, payment, or hands-on run.

useCaseFit.tutoring: Tutors almost any academic subject and helps a teacher plan a lesson.
